# PrintReady AI — full brief

PrintReady AI is a vendor-neutral printability benchmark for AI 3D generators. Scored so far on locked prompts T01–T06: Hunyuan3D-2, Hunyuan3D-2.1 (open-source Tencent), Meshy 6 Lite (free plan, not flagship 7.1), and Tripo H2.5 (free export, not newer paid models). Rodin/Hyper3D, TRELLIS, Hitem3D/Hi3D and Meshy 7.1 are queued (TRELLIS runs hit a free GPU quota; Rodin/Meshy 7.1 need paid plans).

## Scoring weights (rubric v0.2, 2026-10-31)
Watertight 20 · Manifold 15 · Non-manifold edges 10 · Self-intersections 10 · Wall thickness (ray p5) 10 · Hull fill (hollow skin) 10 · Bed contact (flat base, declared up-axis) 10 · Tree-support volume (real OrcaSlicer tree(auto) slice) 10 · Slice success 5 · Print time n/a (reported, not scored until a weekly median exists). Total 100.
Pose: glTF Y-up rotated to Z-up, auto-orient off.
v0.1 weights (2026-10-30, history): Watertight 20 · Manifold 15 · Non-manifold edges 10 · Self-intersections 10 · Thin walls 10 · Slice success 20 · Print time 5 · Support volume 10. v0.1 sliced with supports off, so support and print time were full points for every mesh that sliced.
Hard fail: score capped at 39 if not watertight OR slicer fails.
Export padding: index-degenerate / zero-area filler faces in Space GLB exports are dropped before watertight checks.

## Test-mesh results (rubric v0.2, 2026-10-31 ET; v0.1 in brackets) — TEST MESHES ONLY
These are pipeline validation meshes, not AI generator outputs. Round controls (sphere, torus, capsule) lose bed-contact points in v0.2 because they have no flat base.
- n01_closed_cube: 100 [v0.1 100]
- pd_capsule: 90.2 [v0.1 100]
- pd_cylinder: 100 [v0.1 100]
- pd_icosphere: 89.1 [v0.1 100]
- pd_torus: 88.2 [v0.1 100]
- n05_thin_plate: 90 [v0.1 90]
- n04_intersecting_tets: 80 [v0.1 90]
- n02_open_cube: 35 [v0.1 39]
- n03_internal_wall: 30 [v0.1 39]

## AI-generator results: Hunyuan3D-2 (rubric v0.2 re-score 2026-10-31 ET; first scored 2026-10-30)
Pipeline: locked prompt -> FLUX.1-schnell reference image (seed 1234) -> Hunyuan3D-2 public Hugging Face Space (seed 1234, 30 steps, octree 256). Raw output, no repair. Scores after export-padding cleanup.
- T01 Coffee mug: v0.2 score 98.2/100 (v0.1 100), watertight yes, tree support 8.9% of extrusion, bed contact 317.8 mm2, hull fill 19.2%
- T02 Fox figurine: v0.2 score 86.9/100 (v0.1 100), watertight yes, tree support 24.3% of extrusion, bed contact 21.6 mm2, hull fill 35.6%
- T03 Hex nut: v0.2 score 89.8/100 (v0.1 100), watertight yes, tree support 23.3% of extrusion, bed contact 38.8 mm2, hull fill 61.8%
- T04 Phone stand: v0.2 score 100/100 (v0.1 100), watertight yes, tree support 3.5% of extrusion, bed contact 612.3 mm2, hull fill 31.7%
- T05 Card holder: v0.2 score 26.9/100 (v0.1 39), watertight no, tree support 53.8% of extrusion, bed contact 49 mm2, hull fill n/a
- T06 Planter pot: v0.2 score 91.7/100 (v0.1 100), watertight yes, tree support 30% of extrusion, bed contact 133 mm2, hull fill 21.9%
Summary: 5/6 watertight after padding cleanup, 6/6 sliced; 1/6 score 100 on v0.2 (5/6 on v0.1). Meshy 6 Lite and Tripo H2.5 free export scored; Hitem3D, Rodin, TRELLIS queued (not yet scored).

## AI-generator results: Hunyuan3D-2.1 (rubric v0.2, scored 2026-10-31 ET)
Pipeline: same FLUX.1-schnell reference images (seed 1234) -> tencent/Hunyuan3D-2.1 public Hugging Face Space, shape model hunyuan3d-dit-v2-1 (seed 1234, 30 steps, guidance 5.0, octree 256, shape only). Raw output, no repair.
- T01 Coffee mug: v0.2 score 81.7/100, watertight yes, tree support 5.1% of extrusion, bed contact 2485.4 mm2, hull fill 7.6%, wall p5 0.293 mm; original run included a thin square plate (input artifact, see correction)
- T02 Fox figurine: v0.2 score 83.2/100, watertight yes, tree support 29.3% of extrusion, bed contact 13.4 mm2, hull fill 34.3%, wall p5 1.942 mm
- T03 Hex nut: v0.2 score 96.7/100, watertight yes, tree support 9.9% of extrusion, bed contact 67.8 mm2, hull fill 89.5%, wall p5 2.437 mm; long hex prism lying on its side
- T04 Phone stand: v0.2 score 81.6/100, watertight yes, tree support 0% of extrusion, bed contact 2488 mm2, hull fill 7.4%, wall p5 0.289 mm; original run included a thin square plate (input artifact, see correction)
- T05 Card holder: v0.2 score 73.8/100, watertight yes, tree support 26.6% of extrusion, bed contact 2482.4 mm2, hull fill 6.5%, wall p5 0.3 mm; original run included a thin square plate (input artifact, see correction)
- T06 Planter pot: v0.2 score 82.3/100, watertight yes, tree support 0% of extrusion, bed contact 2482.5 mm2, hull fill 8.4%, wall p5 0.29 mm; original run included a thin square plate (input artifact, see correction)
Summary: 6/6 watertight single bodies, 0 hard fails, 6/6 sliced. Correction 2026-10-31: the thin square plate on T01, T04, T05 and T06 in the original run was an input artifact (the Space's built-in background removal kept the off-white image frame), not a model trait. Re-test with locally matted RGBA input (rembg isnet-general-use, Space removal off), same seed 1234 and settings: plate gone on all 4; T01 86.6, T04 98.2, T05 72.2, T06 95.6; all 4 watertight single bodies. Published table keeps the original protocol until all generators are re-run with matted inputs. Both scored models are open-source Tencent models; this is not a cross-vendor comparison. Meshy 6 Lite and Tripo H2.5 free export scored; Hitem3D, Rodin, TRELLIS queued (not yet scored).

## Positioning and limits (updated 2026-10-31)
Other AI-mesh printability benchmarks exist: PrintCheck, 3dtoolwiki, Topoheal, and Meshy's own benchmark. PrintReady AI focuses on locked prompts, one FDM profile (Bambu Lab A1, OrcaSlicer 2.4.2, PLA), open CC BY 4.0 data, and planned weekly re-runs (one run so far, Oct 30-31, 2026). Meshy's built-in printability check covers Meshy output only.
Current limits: four generators, three vendors scored (Hunyuan3D-2, Hunyuan3D-2.1, Meshy 6 Lite free plan — not flagship 7.1, Tripo H2.5 free export — not newer paid models; prompts T01-T06); Meshy 7.1, Rodin, TRELLIS and Hitem3D are queued; print time is reported but not scored; the free file checker (/check/) runs geometry checks only, no slicing. For functional parts with tolerances, CAD remains the better tool.

## Free file checker (added 2026-10-31)
URL: https://basileion.github.io/printready/check/
Input: STL (binary or ASCII), OBJ, GLB, self-contained .gltf. Parsed and checked with JavaScript in the browser; the file is never uploaded. Draco/meshopt-compressed GLBs are not supported (re-export uncompressed or as STL).
Checks: watertight (every edge shared by exactly 2 faces); non-manifold edge count = edges not shared by exactly 2 faces (rubric v0.2: 0 full points, 1-5 half, >5 zero); zero-area / index-degenerate faces (dropped first, as the scorer's export-padding rule); connected parts and parts starting >0.2 mm above the bed; inconsistent winding / inside-out normals; volume (watertight only); bed contact = down-facing area within 0.2 mm of the bed (rubric v0.2: <=10 mm2 zero, >=100 mm2 full); fit on a Bambu A1 bed (256 x 256 x 256 mm). Units and up axis are selectable (defaults: STL/OBJ mm and Z-up, GLB meters and Y-up; unit-less AI exports are scaled to 50 mm like the benchmark).
Validation (2026-10-31): on the published Hunyuan3D-2 and Hunyuan3D-2.1 meshes scaled to 50 mm, the browser checker matches the scorer's watertight, non-manifold edge count, body count, export-padding count and bed contact exactly.
Not checked in the browser: wall thickness, self-intersections, hull fill, overhangs/tree supports, slice success. Geometry checks only, not a slicer run.


## Compare: Hunyuan3D-2 vs Hunyuan3D-2.1 (published 2026-11-06)
URL: https://basileion.github.io/printready/compare/hunyuan3d-2-vs-2-1/
Both open-weights Tencent. Main-table means on rubric v0.2, same 6 locked prompts: Hunyuan3D-2 ~82.2 (5/6 watertight; T05 hard-fail 26.9) vs Hunyuan3D-2.1 ~83.2 (6/6 watertight). HY2.1 main-table T01/T04/T05/T06 included a thin ground plate from Space background removal on off-white refs (wall ~0.29 mm, hull fill ~7%); correction re-test with local matted RGBA removed the plate on 4/4 (T01 86.6, T04 98.2, T05 72.2, T06 95.6). Main scorecard table unchanged (same protocol). Printable ≠ matches prompt: HY2.1 T03 scored 96.7 but was a hex prism / wrong shape. Matches prompt? column now live on the scorecard (T03 = no).



## Tripo H2.5 (free export; scored 2026-11-07 ET)
Not a newer paid Tripo model — free exports are H2.5 only (15/mo). Same locked FLUX refs → image-to-3D → H2.5–Legacy, texture off, free export ($0).
Scores (rubric v0.2): T01 29.3, T02 18.4, T03 23.2, T04 29.8, T05 25.0, T06 31.5. Mean ~26.2. 0/6 watertight, 6/6 hard-fail, 6/6 sliced. Matches prompt? blank pending human review.
Open data: https://basileion.github.io/printready/data/scores.csv · meshes under data/meshes/tripo_h25/

## Compare: Meshy vs Tripo (published 2026-11-07; printability head-to-head)
URL: https://basileion.github.io/printready/compare/meshy-vs-tripo/
Buyer query page. Free downloads? Meshy free plan: 10 untextured Meshy 6 Lite/mo (CC BY 4.0 sell-with-credit; checked 2026-10-31). Tripo free: 15 exports, H2.5 only, non-commercial (checked 2026-11-06). Entry paid both ~$20/mo. Printability on locked T01–T06 (rubric v0.2): Meshy 6 Lite free plan (not flagship 7.1) mean ~77.9 (6/6 watertight; T05 slice hard-fail 39.0) vs Tripo H2.5 free export mean ~26.2 (0/6 watertight; 6/6 hard-fail; 6/6 sliced; T01 29.3, T02 18.4, T03 23.2, T04 29.8, T05 25.0, T06 31.5). Not newer paid Tripo models. Matches prompt? Meshy T03 = no; Tripo blank pending human review. Costs CSV: https://basileion.github.io/printready/data/costs.csv. Scores CSV: https://basileion.github.io/printready/data/scores.csv.

## Compare: Meshy 6 Lite vs Hunyuan3D-2.1 (published 2026-11-07)
URL: https://basileion.github.io/printready/compare/meshy-6-lite-vs-hunyuan3d-2-1/
First cross-vendor head-to-head. Rubric v0.2 means on the same 6 locked prompts: free-plan Meshy 6 Lite (not flagship 7.1) ~77.9 (6/6 watertight; T05 slice hard-fail 39.0, Orca exit 156) vs open-weights Hunyuan3D-2.1 ~83.2 (6/6 watertight, 0 hard fails). Meshy T01 scored 99.5 and nearly ties Hunyuan3D-2 (98.2). HY2.1 main-table T01/T04/T05/T06 included a Space-rembg ground plate (input artifact); matted re-test T01 86.6, T04 98.2, T05 72.2, T06 95.6. Printable ≠ matches prompt: HY2.1 T03 scored 96.7 but was a hex prism / wrong shape. Tripo H2.5 free export is scored (mean ~26.2). Meshy-vs-Tripo printability head-to-head: https://basileion.github.io/printready/compare/meshy-vs-tripo/ (Meshy ~77.9 vs Tripo H2.5 ~26.2).


## Matches prompt? (2026-11-07)

Disclosed human review of each published thumb against the locked FLUX.1-schnell reference (seed 1234). Values: yes / partial / no. Not part of the 100-pt printability rubric. Across 18 scored rows: 9 yes, 7 partial, 2 no.
- Hunyuan3D-2.1 T03 = no (long hex prism; printability 96.7)
- Meshy 6 Lite T03 = no (tall stacked hex coupler; printability 80.0)
- Printability means stay geometric/slicer-only; rows with matches_prompt=no are excluded from any best/highest claim.
- CSV: https://basileion.github.io/printready/data/matches_prompt.csv and columns on scores.csv
- Method: https://basileion.github.io/printready/methodology/#matches-prompt

## Costs
- [What it costs to get a printable AI 3D model](https://basileion.github.io/printready/costs/): plan prices, free tiers, Free downloads? column, cost per model and licenses (CSV: https://basileion.github.io/printready/data/costs.csv). Free downloads: Hunyuan Space yes; Meshy 10 Lite/mo; Tripo 15 exports H2.5 only (2026-11-06; H2.5 free export scored mean ~26.2); queued Hitem3D ~7 trial; MakerLab 2; PrintPal 10 Draft; MakeIt3D free/packs STL/3MF (CC BY-NC; Light ~$20/30 credits, Heavy $50/300; not scored yet). Scored: Hunyuan3D-2, Hunyuan3D-2.1, Meshy 6 Lite, Tripo H2.5 free export; Rodin, Hitem3D, MakeIt3D, Meshy 7.1 queued.
- Price facts checked 2026-10-31 / 2026-11-07 (Meshy 6 Lite and Tripo H2.5 free export are scored; Meshy 7.1, Rodin, Hitem3D and MakerLab engines are queued): MakerLab Image to 3D on MakerWorld gives 2 free generations per account, then 24 credits (Tripo AI 3.1 or Hitem3D 2.1), 28 (Hunyuan 3D 3.1) or 45 (Meshy 6 or Rodin Gen-2) at $3 per 350 credits, about $0.21, $0.24 or $0.39 per generation; Meshy free tier: 100 credits/mo + 10 untextured Meshy 6 Lite downloads/mo; Meshy 6/7/7.1 and textured models need Pro to download (our 2026-10-31 free-account test used 7.1 and hit the Pro paywall); Hitem3D (queued) Pro is $19.90/mo for 1,000 credits ($9.95/mo first year for new users) and its free tier is 100 trial credits, 'up to 7 models'.

Disclosure (2026-10-31): scores are slicer- and geometry-measured (OrcaSlicer 2.4.2 + trimesh); nothing has been physically printed yet.

## Prompt pack v0.2 (2026-11-07 ET) — thin-feature prompts not scored yet
- Pack version: v0.2. Scored prompts remain T01–T06 only.
- T07 (new, unscored): A miniature fantasy sword standing upright, thin blade under 1.5mm thick at 32mm tall scale, solid hilt, 3D printable, no base
- T08 (new, unscored): A 28mm scale fantasy warrior miniature, separate thin sword arm pose, solid single body preferred, 3D printable, no base
- Prior v0.1 T07 (torus chain) and T08 (XYZ cube) were never scored on any generator; replaced before first score (RT-20261107-03 partial).

## Costs: Hunyuan 3D 3.1 hosted / MakerLab (2026-11-07, not scored)
- Tencent Cloud API prepaid from $15/1,000 credits ($0.015/cr); postpaid $0.02/cr; Professional Normal 25 credits (~$0.375 prepaid), Geometry 15 (~$0.225); one-time 200 trial credits.
- MakerLab Image to 3D: Hunyuan 3D 3.1 = 28 credits ≈ $0.24 on $3/350 pack; 2 free gens/account shared across engines.
- Sources: https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1281/74121 and https://makerworld.com/en/makerlab-credit-full-guide. Not printability-scored.
